News search from 17 October 2026 in English and Czech, with the industry ministry's press release listing (newest 5 November). Left for review: the cabinet's approval on 9 November of the AI Act implementation bill, which proposes roles for the telecoms regulator ČTÚ, the central bank and the data protection authority and allocates sandboxes, and the creation of a Government AI Council, both from a separate ministry release of 9 November. The bill is not yet enacted, and no qualifying AI safety institute was identified. Partial check, not a full record re-check.

check.language_note: The recorded cs query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: CZ-search = searches 1, 2 (en, cs). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The regulator describes its new AI department and supervisory powers dependent on legislation; this supports the regulatory setup rather than an evaluation institute.
